question: In the 2014-15 regular season, which team had the highest average home attendance, and how far ahead of the second-highest team was it?
sql:
SELECT
    team_name,
    average_home_attendance,
    second_highest_team,
    second_highest_average_attendance,
    average_home_attendance - second_highest_average_attendance AS attendance_lead
FROM (
    SELECT
        g.team_name_home AS team_name,
        AVG(i.attendance) AS average_home_attendance,
        LEAD(g.team_name_home) OVER (ORDER BY AVG(i.attendance) DESC, g.team_name_home) AS second_highest_team,
        LEAD(AVG(i.attendance)) OVER (ORDER BY AVG(i.attendance) DESC, g.team_name_home) AS second_highest_average_attendance
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT game_id, team_id_home, team_name_home
        FROM game
        WHERE season_id = '22014'
          AND season_type = 'Regular Season'
    ) AS g
    JOIN (
        SELECT game_id, MAX(attendance) AS attendance
        FROM game_info
        GROUP BY game_id
    ) AS i ON g.game_id = i.game_id
    GROUP BY g.team_id_home, g.team_name_home
    HAVING COUNT(i.attendance) > 0
) AS ranked
ORDER BY average_home_attendance DESC, team_name
LIMIT 1

question: What were the five biggest single-season improvements in regular-season win percentage by an NBA team?
sql:
SELECT
    team_name,
    CAST(previous_season AS VARCHAR) || '-' || RIGHT(CAST(previous_season + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2) AS previous_season,
    CAST(season AS VARCHAR) || '-' || RIGHT(CAST(season + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2) AS season,
    previous_wins,
    previous_games,
    wins,
    games,
    ROUND(previous_win_pct * 100, 3) AS previous_win_percentage,
    ROUND(win_pct * 100, 3) AS win_percentage,
    ROUND((win_pct - previous_win_pct) * 100, 3) AS improvement_percentage_points
FROM (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(season) OVER franchise_seasons AS previous_season,
        LAG(wins) OVER franchise_seasons AS previous_wins,
        LAG(games) OVER franchise_seasons AS previous_games,
        LAG(win_pct) OVER franchise_seasons AS previous_win_pct
    FROM (
        SELECT
            team_id,
            season,
            MAX(team_name) AS team_name,
            COUNT(*) AS games,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wl = 'W') AS wins,
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wl = 'W') * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS win_pct
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                game_id,
                CAST(SUBSTR(season_id, 2) AS INTEGER) AS season,
                team_id_home AS team_id,
                team_name_home AS team_name,
                wl_home AS wl
            FROM game
            WHERE season_type = 'Regular Season'
            UNION
            SELECT DISTINCT
                game_id,
                CAST(SUBSTR(season_id, 2) AS INTEGER) AS season,
                team_id_away AS team_id,
                team_name_away AS team_name,
                wl_away AS wl
            FROM game
            WHERE season_type = 'Regular Season'
        ) AS team_games
        GROUP BY team_id, season
    ) AS season_records
    WINDOW franchise_seasons AS (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY season)
) AS season_changes
WHERE season = previous_season + 1
ORDER BY win_pct - previous_win_pct DESC, season, team_name
LIMIT 5

question: What was the fewest points a team scored in a single quarter of a 2018-19 regular-season game, and which team was it?

FROM line_score AS l
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT game_id
    FROM game
    WHERE season_id = '22018'

) AS g ON l.game_id = g.game_id

    VALUES
        (l.team_city_name_home || ' ' || l.team_nickname_home, TRY_CAST(l.pts_qtr1_home AS INTEGER)),
        (l.team_city_name_home || ' ' || l.team_nickname_home, TRY_CAST(l.pts_qtr2_home AS INTEGER)),
        (l.team_city_name_home || ' ' || l.team_nickname_home, TRY_CAST(l.pts_qtr3_home AS INTEGER)),
        (l.team_city_name_home || ' ' || l.team_nickname_home, TRY_CAST(l.pts_qtr4_home AS INTEGER)),
        (l.team_city_name_away || ' ' || l.team_nickname_away, TRY_CAST(l.pts_qtr1_away AS INTEGER)),

question: Who scored the most points in a single regular-season game in 2015-16, and how many points was it?
sql:
SELECT player1_name AS player_name, SUM(points) AS points
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.game_id,
        p.eventnum,
        p.player1_id,
        p.player1_name,
        CASE
            WHEN p.eventmsgtype = 1 THEN
                CASE WHEN concat(p.homedescription, p.visitordescription) ILIKE '%3PT%' THEN 3 ELSE 2 END
            WHEN p.eventmsgtype = 3
                 AND concat(p.homedescription, p.visitordescription) NOT ILIKE '%MISS%'
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS points
    FROM play_by_play AS p
    WHERE p.eventmsgtype IN (1, 3)
      AND p.game_id IN (
          SELECT game_id
          FROM game
          WHERE season_id = '22015'
            AND season_type = 'Regular Season'
      )
) AS scoring
GROUP BY game_id, player1_id, player1_name
QUALIFY DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(points) DESC) = 1

SELECT
    t.full_name AS team,
    a.avg_home_attendance,
    LEAD(t.full_name) OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_home_attendance DESC, t.id) AS second_highest_team,
    LEAD(a.avg_home_attendance) OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_home_attendance DESC, t.id) AS second_highest_avg_attendance,
    a.avg_home_attendance
        - LEAD(a.avg_home_attendance) OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_home_attendance DESC, t.id) AS attendance_gap
FROM (
    SELECT
        g.team_id_home,
        AVG(i.attendance) AS avg_home_attendance
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT game_id, team_id_home
        FROM game
        WHERE season_id = '22014'

        SELECT game_id, MAX(attendance) AS attendance
        FROM game_info
        GROUP BY game_id
    ) AS i ON i.game_id = g.game_id
    GROUP BY g.team_id_home
    HAVING COUNT(i.attendance) > 0
) AS a
JOIN team AS t ON t.id = a.team_id_home
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.avg_home_attendance DESC, t.id) = 1

    ROUND(100.0 * win_pct, 3) AS win_percentage,

        SELECT
            s.team_id,

            CAST(SUBSTR(g.season_id, 2) AS INTEGER) AS season_year,
            COUNT(DISTINCT g.game_id) AS games,

question: Who scored the most points in a single regular-season game in 2015-16, and how many points was it?
sql:
SELECT player_name, points
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.game_id,
        p.player1_id,
        MAX(p.player1_name) AS player_name,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN p.eventmsgtype = 1 THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN CONCAT_WS(' ', p.homedescription, p.visitordescription) ILIKE '%3PT%' THEN 3
                        ELSE 2
                    END
                WHEN p.eventmsgtype = 3
                     AND CONCAT_WS(' ', p.homedescription, p.visitordescription) NOT ILIKE '%MISS%'
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS points
    FROM play_by_play AS p
    WHERE p.eventmsgtype IN (1, 3)
      AND p.player1_id <> '0'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM game AS g
          WHERE g.game_id = p.game_id
            AND g.season_id = '22015'
            AND g.season_type = 'Regular Season'
      )
    GROUP BY p.game_id, p.player1_id
) AS player_game_points
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY points DESC) = 1

question: In the 2014-15 regular season, which team had the highest average home attendance, and how far ahead of the second-highest team was it?
sql:
SELECT team_name, average_home_attendance, average_home_attendance - second_highest_attendance AS attendance_lead
FROM (
    SELECT
        g.team_name_home AS team_name,
        AVG(i.attendance) AS average_home_attendance,
        LEAD(AVG(i.attendance)) OVER (ORDER BY AVG(i.attendance) DESC) AS second_highest_attendance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(i.attendance) DESC) AS attendance_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT game_id, team_id_home, team_name_home
        FROM game
        WHERE season_id = '22014'
    ) AS g
    JOIN (
        SELECT game_id, AVG(attendance) AS attendance
        FROM game_info
        GROUP BY game_id
    ) AS i ON i.game_id = g.game_id
    GROUP BY g.team_id_home, g.team_name_home
) AS ranked
WHERE attendance_rank = 1

question: What were the five biggest single-season improvements in regular-season win percentage by an NBA team?
sql:
WITH team_games AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        game_id,
        CAST(SUBSTR(season_id, 2) AS INTEGER) AS season_year,
        team_id_home AS team_id,
        team_name_home AS team_name,
        wl_home AS result
    FROM game
    WHERE season_type = 'Regular Season'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT
        game_id,
        CAST(SUBSTR(season_id, 2) AS INTEGER) AS season_year,
        team_id_away AS team_id,
        team_name_away AS team_name,
        wl_away AS result
    FROM game
    WHERE season_type = 'Regular Season'
),
season_records AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        season_year,
        MAX(team_name) AS team_name,
        COUNT(*) AS games_played,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'W') AS wins,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'L') AS losses,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 'W') * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS win_pct
    FROM team_games
    GROUP BY team_id, season_year
),
comparisons AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(season_year) OVER w AS previous_season_year,
        LAG(wins) OVER w AS previous_wins,
        LAG(losses) OVER w AS previous_losses,
        LAG(win_pct) OVER w AS previous_win_pct
    FROM season_records
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY team_id ORDER BY season_year)
)
SELECT
    team_name,
    CAST(previous_season_year AS VARCHAR) || '-' ||
        RIGHT(CAST(previous_season_year + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2) AS previous_season,
    previous_wins,
    previous_losses,
    ROUND(previous_win_pct * 100, 3) AS previous_win_percentage,
    CAST(season_year AS VARCHAR) || '-' ||
        RIGHT(CAST(season_year + 1 AS VARCHAR), 2) AS improved_season,
    wins,
    losses,
    ROUND(win_pct * 100, 3) AS win_percentage,
    ROUND((win_pct - previous_win_pct) * 100, 3) AS improvement_percentage_points
FROM comparisons
WHERE season_year = previous_season_year + 1
ORDER BY win_pct - previous_win_pct DESC, season_year, team_name
LIMIT 5
